title: Tourists at Niagara Falls, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot taken on June 13, 1949, capturing a family at a scenic overlook near Niagara Falls and the Peace Bridge. A man in post-war leisure wear leans casually on a wire fence railing, while a woman holding a young child stands next to a classic vintage coin-operated tower viewer telescope. The image highlights post-WWII American road trip culture and tourist destinations, though it features a notable light exposure glare across the top half of the frame.
